visualCharacteristics: Ice band with an ink section title, a short horizontal rule beside rich body text, and the client logo on the right (cols 9-11 from 1024).
contentPattern: Cells classified by content, order-tolerant: first heading = title, a picture = client logo, every other node = body text.
usage: Use on case-study pages to introduce the client with a title, short description and the client logo.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any client or partner introduction on a case study; author heading, text and one logo image in any order.
